style.summary: Evening luxe: a warm, moody high-rise apartment at dusk. Full-height walnut wall panelling, honed travertine and grey-veined marble, soft cream and taupe upholstery with rust and cognac cushions, bronze and brushed-brass details. Every room glows: cove lights in stepped false ceilings, LED strips under shelves and along wall reveals, wall-washer downlights, linear and globe pendants. Floor-to-ceiling glass with a city skyline outside.
features: full-height walnut wall panelling with LED reveals
stepped false ceilings with warm cove light
lit walnut shelving and media walls
stone spa bathrooms with floating vanities
deep cream sectionals with rust cushions

tour.intro: Welcome to your sky residence—a warm sanctuary suspended above the city, designed to glow as evening falls.

stops.say: You arrive through a stone feature wall and immediately feel the scale of this space. A fluted console and globe pendants set the tone for what's ahead.
At 642 square feet, this is the heart of the home—walnut media wall, cream sectional, and cognac chairs create warmth. The walnut dining table anchors entertaining, while trees soften every corner.
A more intimate gathering space with a sectional, cognac lounge chair, and nesting coffee tables. The media wall glows softly, inviting you to settle in.
The designer kitchen meets a honed marble island with bar seating for three. Walnut tall panelling and linear pendant lighting create a warm workspace that feels lived-in, not showy.
Step outside to 270 square feet of your own sky. Lounge chairs, outdoor sofa, and planters frame the city skyline—this is where evening light lingers longest.
At 302 square feet, your bedroom feels like a retreat—king bed with walnut wall, lounge chair, media console, and a fiddle-leaf fig. Cove lighting casts a gentle glow.
Ninety square feet of organized luxury: walnut walls, a closet island, and globe pendants so you actually want to get dressed here.
A floating vanity, stone shower, and a touch of greenery make this 69-square-foot sanctuary feel more spa than bathroom.
This 254-square-foot bedroom has its own presence: queen bed with walnut wall, lounge chair, and an olive tree that grounds the space.
The third bedroom breathes differently with a cognac leather wall, queen bed, wardrobe, and kentia palm. Each room in this home has its own character.

tour.outro: Every surface, every light, every detail is here to support how you'll actually live—tell me what speaks to you, or what you'd like to adjust.
